authorization_context: Owner explicitly requested one thinking-mode trial; spend within existing authorization.

cost_accounting.policy: Uncached peak-rate upper bound; unverifiable or failed calls retain full reservation.

decoding_note: temperature=0 remains in the request but is ignored by the provider in thinking mode; top_p=1.

evaluation.mechanical: Retain every initial, repaired and failed response; distinguish compilation from semantic correctness.
evaluation.reference: Author audit against these predeclared source boundaries, not independent human gold or model-review approval.
semantic: Operation predicate excludes concrete participants/conditions/order while preserving action/API distinctions.
Actual participant roles must be source-supported; ambiguous username insertion may remain unresolved, not become confirmed absence.
Password hashing-before-insertion and named privilege ordering must remain requirement-owned; operation presence alone is not independent context.
Generation output contract, task-wide behavior and exception condition remain represented; supported unrelated requirements survive repair.
evaluation.unit: One natural task; extraction/review/patch calls are not independent task samples.

limits: No protected/new tasks, Discovery, code outcomes, paper or Pair changes.
Same case input, instruction, catalog, schema, implementation and evaluation criteria as the completed non-thinking batch.
One draw per task; no extra reviewer, resampling or parameter tuning.
Thinking and resource limits change together. This is a descriptive configuration comparison, not an isolated causal effect of thinking.
No seeded decoding guarantee; temperature is ineffective in thinking mode. This is not a repeated stability estimate.
Missing final content or non-stop finish is retained as delivery failure; reasoning text is never parsed into a replacement graph.
purpose: Repeat the same two exposed tasks with thinking enabled and larger delivery limits; parse final content only through the unchanged source pipeline.
stop_rule: Complete the two planned cases with only the existing mechanical correction/review/local-patch limits; no rerun, fallback model, retuning or extra reviewer after outcomes.
thinking_effort: Provider default high; reasoning_effort is not explicitly sent by the unchanged client.
